 What to know before San Jose State kicks off at Air Force 
 Last time they visited Falcon Stadium, the Spartans got their first-ever road win at Air Force

 San Jose State’s Steve Chavez-Soto (15) runs for a touchdown against Air Force in the fourth quarter of their game at San Jose State University in San Jose, Calif., on Saturday, Nov. 8, 2025. Air Force defeated San Jose State 26-16. (Jose Carlos Fajardo/Bay Area News Group)
 By Haddy Barghouti PUBLISHED: November 14, 2026 at 5:15 AM PST | UPDATED: November 14, 2026 at 5:16 AM PST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... San Jose State at Air Force 
 Records: San Jose State (5-5, 3-3 Mountain West), Air Force (7-2, 3-2 MW)
 Kickoff: 4 p.m. Saturday at Falcon Stadium, Colorado Springs
 TV: CBS Sports Network
 Series history: Air Force leads the all-time series 6-3. The last meeting was Nov. 8, 2025, when the Falcons beat the Spartans 26-16 . Air Force won the first meeting 45-0 in 1996. San Jose State won the most recent meeting at Air Force , 17-7 in 2024.
 San Jose State storylines: The Spartans have three games remaining and need two more wins to qualify for a bowl game after missing out last season. … The Spartans will start true freshman quarterback Daniel Rolovich, who is 2-1 as a starter. … San Jose State is looking for just its second win in five visits to Air Force. … The Spartans are coming off a 30-19 win over Northern Illinois . … San Jose State is third in the nation with 36 sacks. … Freshman Carson Clark is second in the Mountain West with six receiving touchdowns. His 61 receptions are tied for the most by a freshman in the nation. … Senior running back Jabari Bates leads the Mountain West with 163 carries. … Junior kicker Trajan Sinatra leads the Mountain West with 20 made field goals, which ranks fourth in the nation. … Junior linebacker Dylan Lee has four interceptions, making him the only linebacker in the nation with that many.

 Air Force storylines: The Falcons are coming off a 24-21 win over Army, which clinched a winning season for the 18th time in the last 20 seasons. … The Falcons won the Commander-in-Chief’s Trophy with the win over Army. … Air Force has not allowed an opening-drive score in five of its last six games. … The Falcons went 4-8 last season. … Junior quarterback Liam Szarka suffered a lower-leg injury and is out for the season. … Air Force has started four quarterbacks this season. … Senior quarterback Kemper Hodges had 119 yards on 17 carries and a touchdown against Army.
 Stats that matter: San Jose State averages 228.2 passing yards per game, second in the Mountain West behind Hawaii. … Air Force allows 160.9 passing yards per game, which ranks second in the Mountain West…. San Jose State has seven rushing touchdowns this season, the fewest in the Mountain West. … Air Force has attempted 77 passes and has 569 rushing attempts this season. … San Jose State allowed 400 yards against Northern Illinois, while the Huskies held the Spartans to 316 yards, but SJSU still came out on top. … Air Force averages 332.0 rushing yards per game.
